variation.description: File DOMAIN-ValidImportExtensionScope-base.json — Base taxonomy (A) defining ProductDomain with two open concept members.
File DOMAIN-ValidImportExtensionScope-derived.json — Middle taxonomy (B) importing A without extending the domain.

File DOMAIN-ValidImportExtensionScope.json — Extension taxonomy (C) using diamond import (B+A) and extending exp:ProductDomain with a third member. Demonstrates that domain extension scope is local to the importing taxonomy's resolved model.
File DOMAIN-ValidDiamondExtendTargetName-base.json — Base taxonomy (A) defining exp:ProductDomain with one concept member. Extended independently by B and C in the diamond extendTargetName test.
File DOMAIN-ValidDiamondExtendTargetName-ext1.json — Extension taxonomy B importing A and independently extending exp:ProductDomain with exp2:ProductB.
File DOMAIN-ValidDiamondExtendTargetName-ext2.json — Extension taxonomy C independently importing A and extending exp:ProductDomain with exp3:ProductC, unaware of taxonomy B.

File DOMAIN-ValidDiamondExtendTargetName.json — Combined taxonomy D importing both B and C. A is processed once via the DAG duplicate-import rule. Resolved exp:ProductDomain contains exp:ProductA, exp2:ProductB, and exp3:ProductC in import order.

File CALCULATION-ValidSummationMultiEntityValue.json - entity domain restricts balance sheet cube to ExampleCompany only, so ExampleCompany2 facts are excluded and its incorrect TotalLiabilities does not trigger a calculation error
